verdict.rationale: Mastra ships a well-documented TypeScript SDK (Agent/Workflow/Tool constructors) and a CLI with an 'api' namespace for triggering workflows/agents programmatically (mastra-docs-29, mastra-docs-14, mastra-docs-31), which is a form of documented public API surface AI-native users could drive. However, a direct probe found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec (mastra-probe-3: all candidate paths 404), so there's no formal REST API contract, only SDK/CLI-level documentation. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/REST spec, independent confirmation of API stability/versioning, and explicit documentation of HTTP endpoints beyond the CLI wrapper.
